corpus.split_policy: The final 10% of the text, as one contiguous block, is held out. Never shuffled: a random split would place a line in training and the next line in validation, so the model would be scored on completing a passage it had effectively already read.

tokenizer.note: Character-level: the entire vocabulary is 65 printable symbols, so nothing about the input representation is hidden.

uniform_random.description: Guess uniformly among 65 characters -- the absolute floor.

unigram_frequency.description: Always predict the marginal character distribution, ignoring context entirely. Any model that does not beat this has learned nothing about language.

character_statistics.note: Cross-entropy is reported in bits per character so it can be compared directly against these two baselines. Nats would make the comparison arithmetic rather than obvious.
